sources.title: Qinghai governor visits China Mobile Plateau Big Data Center Phase 2 construction site on September 2
sources.publisher: Qinghai Daily; Qinghai News (Qinghai Provincial Internet News Center)
sources.attribution: Qinghai Daily; Qinghai News (Qinghai Provincial Internet News Center)
sources.summary: Official leadership activity report records the September 2 site visit and inspection of China Mobile Plateau Big Data Center Phase 2 construction progress.
sources.date_semantics: The opening paragraph explicitly dates the visit September 2; page publication is September 3. Neither retrieval date nor a projected opening is the observation date.
sources.scope_note: Phase 2 aggregate construction project only. Does not assert completion or operation of B01 or any phase/stage.
sources.publisher_authority_note: Primary report of the provincial leadership visit, published in Qinghai News official leadership-activity channel. The captured footer identifies Qinghai Provincial Internet News Center; it is not a construction permit or a cadastral authority.

sources.title: CSCEC Fifth Bureau: Guizhou Information Park B5/B6 civil works accepted September 20
sources.publisher: China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau, Third Construction Company
sources.attribution: China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau, Third Construction Company
sources.summary: The contractor reports September 20 acceptance of the 2.1-phase second civil-works contract for B5/B6, plot MN-02-01HB phase 2, with 34,472 square metres; subsequent equipment commissioning and operation remain future work.
sources.date_semantics: September 20 is the explicit civil-works acceptance date; September 22 is publication.
sources.scope_note: Completed applies to the B5/B6 civil works contract, not commissioned or operating data-center capacity.

sources.title: SASAC official account publishes Guizhou Information Park campus coordinates
sources.publisher: SASAC official Guozi Xiaoxin account, hosted by The Paper
sources.attribution: SASAC official Guozi Xiaoxin account, hosted by The Paper
sources.summary: Government account identifies China Telecom Cloud Computing Guizhou Information Park at latitude 26.38 and longitude 106.54.
sources.publisher_authority_note: Official SASAC social account on a third-party publishing platform; factual campus reference from an institutional report, not a cadastral survey or government geospatial dataset.
sources.scope_note: Named campus approximate reference point only. Not a B5 or B6 building point, entrance, parcel or current work extent.

sources.title: China Telecom official account repeats Guizhou Information Park coordinates
sources.publisher: China Telecom Group official Weibo account, displayed by Sina
sources.attribution: China Telecom Group official Weibo account, displayed by Sina
sources.summary: Verified China Telecom Group account repeats the same named-campus latitude 26.38 and longitude 106.54.
sources.publisher_authority_note: Sina page explicitly marks China Telecom Group official Weibo account. This repeats the SASAC article and is corroborating identity context rather than an independent survey.
